changes.section: Two Pillars Don't Hold The Roof Up
changes.current:
Maybe an unusually strong couple can get away without much community. I think that's rare. Community isn't magic either; if both people are falling apart, there is only so much anyone else can do.

But sometimes a friend who actually knows us both sees the pattern before either of us does.
changes.proposed: Maybe an unusually strong couple can get away without much community. I think that's rare.  But sometimes a friend who actually knows us both sees the pattern before either of us does. On the other hand, If both people are falling apart, there is only so much anyone else can do.
